ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 white-to-black pixel intensity ratio across the composite visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: High-intensity white region occupies ~70% of the internal area, featuring several internal dark linear streaks. Right lobe: Low-intensity black dominates, with a distinct cluster of 4-6 small white circular spots in the medial-lower quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-notch; calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees from the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Densely packed irregular serrations along the full trailing edge. Peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 4 and 15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a significant upward sweep; trailing edges follow a shallow sigmoidal curve terminating in sharply pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, high-intensity white circular marks on the lower right lobe. One prominent isolated white spot at the right-inner base of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertical dark-on-white linear streaks on the left lobe and light-on-black linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme rugosity and irregular contours at both fluke tips, consistent with localized calcification or old trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme bilateral pigmentation asymmetry; the interior of the left lobe is predominantly high-intensity white, while the interior of the right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black.
